summary: AI coworkers must coordinate tools, communicate across turns, and act on changing workspace state while respecting workflow constraints. Constructing training experience for these capabilities requires coherent requests, service records, tool interfaces, and grading checks.
takeaways: Teacher executions yield curated demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while student interactions provide rollouts and rewards for reinforcement learning (RL).
Constructing training experience for these capabilities requires coherent requests, service records, tool interfaces, and grading checks.
Workflow requirements guide task construction, and programmatic validation with feedback repair checks generated specifications and grading behavior.
